full_text_en:
Shen Taifu Embezzlement and Bribery Case

Defendant: Shen Taifu, male, 39 years old, former president of Beijing Great Wall Electromechanical Science and Technology Industry Company, arrested on April 18, 1993.

The Branch of Beijing People's Procuratorate instituted a public prosecution with the Beijing Intermediate People's Court against the defendant Shen Taifu for the crimes of embezzlement and bribery.

The Beijing Intermediate People's Court, after trial, found the following facts:

During his tenure as president of Beijing Great Wall Electromechanical Science and Technology Industry Company (hereinafter Beijing Great Wall Company), on March 2, 1993, the defendant Shen Taifu, under the pretext of borrowing funds for electric motors, filled out a loan slip for RMB 1,000,000 and instructed Sun Jihong (Shen Taifu's wife, co-defendant, already sentenced) to use this loan slip to withdraw RMB 1,000,000 from the company's fundraising department, and deposit it into a bank under Sun Jihong's name on March 18 and March 22 of the same year. Thereafter, Sun Jihong instructed the company's accounting department to change the entry from a personal loan of RMB 1,000,000 by Shen Taifu to a payment of RMB 1,000,000 for electric motors to Shenzhen Taifu Company, thereby unlawfully appropriating the funds. After Shen Taifu was subjected to compulsory measures, Sun Jihong returned the RMB 1,000,000 bank deposit slip to Beijing Great Wall Company on April 5, 1993.

In February 1993, the defendant Shen Taifu instructed You Chengshun, president of Shenzhen Taifu Company, and others to issue false invoices for electric motor products sold by Shenzhen Taifu Company in January and February of that year, and falsely reported sales revenue of RMB 205,000,000 to the state tax authorities. In March, Shen Taifu instructed You Chengshun to draft a board resolution allowing Shen Taifu to extract patent fees from Shenzhen Taifu Company at a rate of 10% of sales revenue, and backdated the resolution to January 4, 1993. On March 21 and 23 of the same year, Shen Taifu, under the pretext of borrowing patent fee commissions, filled out two receipts of RMB 1,000,000 each. Using one receipt, he withdrew RMB 1,000,000 from Shenzhen Taifu Company; the other he gave to You Chengshun to withdraw cash for him. From the so-called commission fee of RMB 1,000,000 that Shen Taifu withdrew, he gave RMB 400,000 to Sun Jihong, who deposited it under her own name into the fundraising department of Beijing Great Wall Company (recovered after the case was discovered). The remaining RMB 600,000, Shen Taifu gave to certain individuals (RMB 482,000 recovered after the case was discovered). As for the RMB 1,000,000 in cash that Shen Taifu instructed You Chengshun to withdraw on his behalf, after Shen Taifu was subjected to compulsory measures, You Chengshun and others decided to use that money to pay RMB 320,000 for Shen Taifu's individual income adjustment tax and to offset RMB 680,000 of Shen Taifu's personal loans from Shenzhen Taifu Company.

After the case was discovered, RMB 482,000 of the illicit money embezzled by Shen Taifu was recovered.

From 1989 to before March 1993, the defendant Shen Taifu, in order to seek illegitimate benefits for Beijing Great Wall Company, bribed 21 state functionaries, including Li Xiaoshi, Deputy Director of the State Science and Technology Commission (all dealt with in separate cases), with money and goods totaling over RMB 250,000.

The above facts are confirmed by the testimony of witnesses including Hu Kongcai, You Chengshun, and others, as well as evidence such as Shen Taifu's loan slips, account books, bank passbooks and deposit slips in the name of Sun Jihong, and the recovered illicit money.

The Beijing Intermediate People's Court held: The defendant Shen Taifu, as the responsible person of a collective economic organization, took advantage of his position and used deceptive means to embezzle public funds. His conduct constitutes the crime of embezzlement under Article 1 of the "Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery" (hereinafter "Supplementary Provisions"). Shen Taifu sought illegitimate benefits for his enterprise by bribing state functionaries, and his conduct constitutes the crime of bribery under Article 9 of the "Supplementary Provisions". Shen Taifu committed multiple crimes. According to Article 64, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, he shall be subject to concurrent punishment for multiple crimes. According to Article 12 of the "Supplementary Provisions", all embezzled public property shall be recovered; according to Article 55 of the Criminal Law, all personal property of Shen Taifu shall be confiscated; and according to Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, Shen Taifu shall be deprived of political rights for life.

Accordingly, on March 4, 1994, the Beijing Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

The defendant Shen Taifu is found guilty of embezzlement and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property; guilty of bribery and sentenced to four years' imprisonment; the combined sentence is execution by death, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property. The recovered illicit money of RMB 482,000 from the defendant Shen Taifu is to be confiscated.

After the first instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant Shen Taifu appealed to the Beijing High People's Court. Shen Taifu's grounds for appeal were: Beijing Great Wall Company is a false collective but actually private enterprise, so the defendant cannot be the subject of the crime of embezzlement, and he had no motive or act of embezzlement, thus not constituting the crime of embezzlement. Shen Taifu's defense counsel submitted that the second instance should re-confirm the economic nature of Beijing Great Wall Company, and Shen Taifu's conduct should not be characterized as embezzlement; moreover, most of the case funds had been recovered, and Shen Taifu had confessed to bribery and exposed multiple persons for bribery, so he should be given a lighter punishment.

The Beijing High People's Court, upon trial, held: The appellant Shen Taifu, as the responsible person of a collective economic organization, took advantage of his position to embezzle a large amount of public funds, and his conduct constitutes the crime of embezzlement. Shen Taifu bribed multiple state functionaries to seek illegitimate benefits for Beijing Great Wall Company, and his conduct constitutes the crime of bribery. Beijing Great Wall Company is a collectively owned enterprise, as evidenced not only by its business license but also confirmed by the Haidian District Administration for Industry and Commerce of Beijing. Shen Taifu's appeal denying the collective ownership nature of Beijing Great Wall Company and his claim that he cannot be the subject of embezzlement are unfounded. The facts of Shen Taifu's embezzlement of the company's fundraising funds are confirmed by the testimony of multiple witnesses from the company, Shen Taifu's loan slips, the company's account books, accounting vouchers, and the bank passbooks and deposit slips in the name of Sun Jihong, and are sufficient for determination. Shen Taifu's appeal denying the motive and act of embezzlement is inconsistent with reality. The defense counsel's arguments that most of the case funds have been recovered and that Shen Taifu confessed to bribery and exposed others for accepting bribes are insufficient to mitigate Shen Taifu's criminal liability for embezzlement, and the request for a lighter punishment is not accepted. The first instance judgment, based on the facts, nature, circumstances, consequences, and degree of social harm of Shen Taifu's crimes, correctly determined the conviction and application of law, imposed an appropriate sentence, and the trial procedure was lawful. Accordingly, on April 4, 1994, the court, pursuant to Article 136, Item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, ruled to dismiss the appeal of the appellant Shen Taifu and affirmed the original judgment.

The Beijing High People's Court, pursuant to Article 144 of the Criminal Procedure Law, submitted the criminal ruling sentencing the defendant Shen Taifu to death with deprivation of political rights for life to the Supreme People's Court for approval.

The Supreme People's Court, after review, ruled on April 8, 1994, to approve the criminal ruling of the Beijing High People's Court affirming the first instance judgment: sentencing the defendant Shen Taifu to death with deprivation of political rights for life for embezzlement, to four years' imprisonment for bribery, and the combined sentence of death with deprivation of political rights for life.
